name: Eda Bonsai
description: A quiet, organic store theme for a small family bonsai nursery on a hillside in Kodamadai, selling nursery-grown juniper, maple, black pine, azalea and beginner ficus with handmade pots, tools and soil, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Pale moss pages, lichen panels, deep moss ink text and a muted olive accent; Rosarivo for display, Red Hat Text for text. A slim pale-moss rail fixed to the right edge with a hairline left border holds a growth-ring mark, the Rosarivo wordmark set vertically, a fine branch line and the menu stacked below, with account and cart; on phones a plain top bar with the wordmark, Menu and cart on one line (H11). The home page opens with a short title (Trees that keep time) and four chapters (age, styling, watering, repotting) scrolling beside one sticky tree photograph that cross-fades with each chapter, with a thin olive growth-ring index; on phones the photograph sticks to the top in a short band (L13). Then featured trees with an age · height · care level line under each price, the care + delivery promise, this season from the care calendar and the journal. A newsletter-led footer: a calm lichen band for the seasonal care letter, four letters a year, then the nursery details and slim links (F4). Care calendar, Workshops and The nursery pages, journal, newsletter and contact. The nursery details, the care + delivery policy and the care calendar each live in one synced pattern (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop shows static cells and orders go by email).
deviation: Codes: none (H11 + F4 + L13 as planned; combination unused: Menya Kaen H11/F12/L7, Kasumi Bar H11/F3/L5, Kinu Kimono H11/F8/L4; Hana Kago H8/F4/L8, Oto Radio H5/F4/L12, Kumo Eyewear H6/F4/L14; Kaze Yoga H4/F7/L13, Wagu Mono H3/F9/L13, Asa Linen H8/F8/L13; neighbours #16 Engawa Works H9/F5/L6 grey and #18 Shiori Review H5/F8/L3 oat share no code or palette family). Palette as planned (pale moss #EFF0EA, lichen #C7CDB8, deep moss ink #263023, muted olive #6F6A3E) with added colours, all AA-checked: ink is 12.0:1 on pale moss, 8.4:1 on lichen and 12.9:1 on moss paper; muted olive is 4.8:1 on pale moss and 5.2:1 on paper (used there for labels, italic display and ring marks) but only 3.4:1 on lichen, so on lichen it appears only as rules and marks; deep olive #4B4A26 was added for links, small labels and buttons' hover (7.9:1 on pale moss, 5.6:1 on lichen, 8.5:1 on paper); quiet moss #485342 for secondary text (7.1:1 on pale moss, 5.0:1 on lichen); moss paper #F7F8F3 cards and a hairline #B3B9A3 (decorative). Buttons are ink with pale moss text (12.0:1); the letter band is lichen with ink text (8.4:1) and deep olive labels and links (5.6:1). H11 differs from Menya (noren), Kasumi (dark bar menu) and Kinu (plum kimono rail) as a slim 92 px pale-moss rail with a hairline left border, a growth-ring mark, the vertical Rosarivo wordmark, a fine SVG branch line and vertical-set menu items with a small olive ring on the current page; content reserves the rail width. F4 differs from Hana Kago (florist stem letter), Oto (amber podcast band) and Kumo (titanium) as a calm lichen band with a ring mark for the seasonal care letter over a moss colophon with the synced nursery card. L13 differs from Kaze (breath wave), Wagu (drawing plates) and Asa (linen) as one sticky tree photograph cross-fading per chapter (age, styling, watering, repotting) with a vertical growth-ring chapter index joined by a hairline; no JavaScript keeps the first photograph and the index links still jump; prefers-reduced-motion swaps without a fade; on phones the photograph and a horizontal ring index stick under the top bar. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Rosarivo carries the Reserved Font Names 'Rosarivo', 'Rosarivo Pro' and 'Rosarivo UGR', so its Regular and Italic TTFs ship unmodified (41 + 39 KB); Red Hat Text is OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (variable Latin WOFF2 subset, weights 300-700, 30 KB). Three synced patterns: nursery details (footer, Workshops, The nursery, Contact; the footer leaves it out where the page already shows it), care + delivery policy (home short, product page short, Care calendar short, Contact in full) and the care calendar (Care calendar page in full; the home teaser shows only the current season, picked server-side from the WordPress timezone). Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry bonsai-nursery and page tag care-calendar are new (Workshops reuses the workshops tag, The nursery the about tag).
